title: Quality Technical Director
text:
Own the division’s quality strategy end-to-end, ensuring product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance work together to protect quality and meet regulatory expectations.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Set technical and quality direction, translating business goals into practical standards, processes, and performance measures across the value chain.
* Build and lead a high-performing quality organization, coaching teams in root-cause problem solving, risk management, and documentation discipline.
* Strengthen supplier quality through performance reviews, issue containment expectations, and clear escalation paths.
* Lead investigation and resolution of customer quality issues, coordinating internal stakeholders to deliver effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement to enhance product performance and operational effectiveness, identifying systemic gaps and verifying outcomes.

**What You Bring**
Deep experience in quality systems and product safety, strong technical leadership, and a pragmatic approach to compliance and cross-functional execution—able to turn complex investigations into durable improvements.
